text:
Roman Kantserov came over from the KHL this season after 36 goals in 63 games for Metallurg Magnitogorsk, and he has scored right away: 10 goals in his first 23 NHL games. The 22-year-old has worked his way onto Chicago's top power-play unit and, with Anton Frondell out, onto the penalty kill.

For context, forwards picked where he was (34th to 54th overall) have scored a median 0.30 points a game in their first full season. He's at 0.61.

The finishing will cool. He is shooting 26% (10 goals on 5.8 expected), and his last ten games show it: one goal in his last five games after scoring in four straight. Chicago also gets only 40.5% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice, so the team's play is not helping him. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has nothing unusual yet in 8 tracked games, a small sample. What he does have is speed, 96th percentile top speed by NHL Edge tracking. Our range is 20 to 34 goals this season, a wide one because there is so little NHL history to go on.
